item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.6)
item.description:
**Nightly build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Changes
- Unlock approval: shorter warning
- Unlock approval: two short lines instead of a paragraph
- Mac: a one-time What's New screen about the main window
- Mac: choose where received files are saved
- Mac: drop the window button from the popover header
- Unlock setup: the Mac confirms the phone's code itself
- Mac audio on the phone without the driver, chosen like any output
- Mac: a receiving shelf that slides out like the send shelf
- Phone: the Lock tile becomes Set up unlock until the Mac approves the key
- Mac: remove the Now Playing card from Overview
- Phone: remove the "Playing Mac audio" card from Home
- Mac: receiving animation and drag received files out (#16)
- Replace "Listen on Phone" with Phone as Speaker, a real Mac sound output
- Screen streaming: drop sRGB capture conversion, force refresh rate only when needed
- macOS: move popover settings to main window, fix bundle icon metadata, and tone down notification icon attachment
- One Lock/Unlock button on the phone, plus Home and notification fixes
- Flush transfer history once at quit
- Optimize Listen on Phone audio pipeline, battery usage, and error handling
- Fix macOS main window, onboarding, and transfer history performance findings
- Integration fixes after merging the backlog PRs
- Unlock from phone: harden after review
- Android: fall back to other icon sources for mirrored notifications
- Android: don't blame the Mac's version when listen on phone gets no answer
- Listen on phone: play the Mac's audio through the paired phone (#3)
- Docs: correct the authorization plug-in and lock-state sources
- macOS: connect the main window with presence settings, fix review findings
- Unlock the Mac from the phone (experimental, off by default)
- Rename the beta channel to Nightly, with a purple icon and its own app name
- Start Extend from the phone with an "Extend Mac" tile (#4)
- Android: add a Disconnect button that stays disconnected until Connect (#11)
- Screen streaming: even frame pacing, tagged colours, matched refresh rate
- macOS: first-launch onboarding and menu bar / Dock presence (#19)
- macOS: full app window with persistent transfer history (#18)
- Mac: let Apple Music or Spotify take priority on the media card
- Mac: per-app notification click actions (#2)
- Phone scroll: post trackpad-style phased scroll gestures on the Mac (#9)
- Shorten the Updates section descriptions
- Forward headset media buttons from the Mac volume session to the Mac
- Media-button pulse: play right away, also with the phone locked
- Android: repost the media notification only when it visibly changes (#13)

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.5)
item.description:
**Staging build**: a release build that may still have bugs.

### Changes
- Make the HyperOS volume-panel Mac slider experimental and off by default
- Fix QR pairing in release builds: keep ML Kit component registrars
- Fix cold-start crash: declare media-session sync lock before init
- Android: send screen/Wi-Fi power state to the core; drop core debug logs in release
- core: power-aware reconnect, LAN probe, mDNS browser and logging (phone battery/data)
- build(android): enable R8, arm64 release ABI filter, en locale filter, work-runtime 2.11.2, and stripped LTO Rust Android profile
- Android: cut background battery/CPU/RAM work
- Mac: refuse to run a second copy (it would take a random port and the phone could not find it)

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.4)
item.description:
**Staging build** (a release build that may still have bugs).

### New: control whatever is playing on the Mac
- One **Playing on Mac** card for any app (Spotify, YouTube in Safari or Chrome, podcasts, Apple Music), with the app's name on it.
- When an app can't skip tracks (most browsers), **−10 s / +10 s** replace previous/next.
- Apple Music keeps lyrics. The Mac sound card is now just volume and output.
- The phone's media controls (notification and lock screen) follow the same app.

### Fixes
- Android 12: the in-app updater no longer crashes when Android asks to confirm the update.
- Release notes in the update screen are formatted properly.

### Updating
- **From staging 3:** use the in-app update (Mac: menu bar › Check for Updates…; Android: Settings › Updates).
- **From older builds, or on Android 12:** install this one by hand, once.

item.title: Deepsync 0.1.0 (v0.1.0-staging.3)
item.description:
**Staging build** (a release build that may still have bugs).

### New: updates inside the app
This is the last version you install by hand. From now on:
- **Mac:** Deepsync checks for updates by itself. You can also use menu bar icon › right-click › **Check for Updates…**, or Settings › Updates.
- **Android:** Settings › **Updates** › Check for updates. A notification and a Home banner appear when a new version is out. The first update asks you to allow "Install unknown apps" for Deepsync once.
- Staging builds get staging updates. Turn off **Get beta (staging) updates** to only get full releases.

### Install
**Mac** (Apple silicon, macOS 26+): open the DMG and drag Deepsync into Applications. On first open: System Settings › Privacy & Security › **Open Anyway**.

**Android** (Android 12+): Play Protect blocks apps that read notifications when they don't come from the Play Store. Turn off Play Store › profile › Play Protect › ⚙️ › **Scan apps with Play Protect**, install the APK, then turn it back on. If Notification access is greyed out: Settings › Apps › Deepsync › ⋮ › **Allow restricted settings**.

Pair: Mac › Deepsync › Pair phone, then phone › Scan QR code.
